idea-plugin.name: Fennec
idea-plugin.description:
Adds Fennec to JetBrains Air as an installed agent card, backed by a model running on this machine.

The plugin bundles a native Rust sidecar that launches the ACP agent, publishes Fennec through Air's agent registry, and registers its local launch command in Air's installed overlay. The card can be enabled, disabled and removed from Air's Agents page like any other agent. The engine starts on the first prompt, not when Air opens, and stops after it has been idle, so an open IDE costs no model memory. An engine that was already running is attached to and left alone.

Fennec controls sit directly in Air's New Session composer: choose Ask every time, Auto approve, or Full access, select an engine-ready local model, set Auto/Low/Medium/High reasoning, or download the recommended checkpoint. Access changes apply to new permission requests immediately; model and reasoning changes apply to the next agent run.

ACP itself is implemented once, in fennec-core, so the IDE, the desktop app, the CLI and the browser agents share the same protocol behaviour. Optional browser outlets (Fennec's own loop, decided by Liquid's hosted d1.2, and OpenBot) handle URL-scoped tasks when they are running.
